reference_sql:
WITH purchases AS (
  -- one row per purchase event of December 2025 (Dublin days), with its value parameter
  SELECT list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value AS v
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
), export_side AS (
  -- one row: the export's count, and its value read from whichever number slot holds it
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS export_purchases,
    SUM(COALESCE(v.int_value, v.float_value, v.double_value)) AS export_value
  FROM purchases
), first_paid AS (
  -- one row per subscription: when its first payment came in, refunded or not
  SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM payments
  GROUP BY subscription_id
), backend_side AS (
  -- one row: the first payments on the Dublin days of December 2025, refunded ones included
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS backend_first_payments, SUM(p.amount_eur) AS backend_value
  FROM first_paid f
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = f.subscription_id AND p.paid_at = f.first_paid_at
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', f.first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
)
SELECT e.export_purchases, b.backend_first_payments, e.export_value, b.backend_value
FROM export_side e
CROSS JOIN backend_side b

solver.query:
WITH e AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(COALESCE(list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value.int_value, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value.float_value, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value.double_value)) AS v FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
), b AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(first_amount) AS v FROM (SELECT subscription_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at, arg_min(amount_eur, paid_at) AS first_amount FROM payments GROUP BY subscription_id) f
  WHERE strftime(timezone('Europe/Dublin', first_paid_at), '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
)
SELECT e.c AS export_purchases, b.c AS backend_first_payments, e.v AS export_value, b.v AS backend_value
FROM e CROSS JOIN b
